description:
Santiago Ramón y Cajal's drawings of nerve cells and brain tissue (1890s–1920s), the figures that founded neuroscience. Real public-domain works from open-access collections, each with title, date, medium, holding institution, credit, licence, source page and full-resolution link; the first comes back as an image.

Example questions:
- "Show me Cajal's neuron drawings"
- "Old scientific drawings of brain cells"
- "Cajal drawings of the nervous system"

limit.description: How many works to list (1-10, default 5).

narrow.description: Optional extra words to narrow the theme (a place, year or motif).
